title: The Demurrage Impasse
logline: An insulting diplomatic treaty sent by cheap bulk parcel freight gets locked in an automated mail vault for unpaid storage fees, threatening an armed border dispute over a two-credit late fee.

roles.description: Runs an automated orbital mail locker depot; pedantic, obsessed with procedural bylaws, terrified of pension penalties.
An anxious envoy from an asteroid mining canton whose treaty draft will trigger war if delivered with its attached insults.
A heavy planetary customs cutter deployed by the governor to breach the mail locker by main force.
The sovereign asteroid mining league whose tariff treaty was mislabeled by junior postal clerks.
A hollowed asteroid automated postal depot where dead-letter lockers are guarded by automated lockouts.
The neutral diplomatic berthing station where treaty delegations await the arrival of the physical charter.

public_situation: Diplomatic talks between {role:canton_miners} and system customs stalled after the physical treaty parcel was seized for back demurrage at {role:depot_rock_nine}.
private_truth: {role:postal_factor} intentionally categorized the diplomatic cylinder as commercial bulk freight so that compounding late storage penalties would cover his station's operational deficit.

beats.public_change: The automated postal station clamps heavy security dampers over all storage lockers pending unpaid fee settlement.

missions.reason: He refuses to power down the automated locker quarantine until someone delivers bulk silicate ore to repack the vault's micrometeorite blast baffles.
missions.private_fact: He secretly vented the old shielding gravel himself to fabricate an emergency safety condition that legally freezes all parcel releases.

beats.public_change: Customs cutters assemble near the depot rock, announcing imminent forfeiture of all overdue commercial parcel freight.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to extract the released treaty canister from the depot and haul it straight to the consular dock before customs impounds it.
missions.private_fact: He scribbled vulgar caricatures of the customs commissioner in the treaty margins during a drunken committee recess three years ago.

beats.public_change: Customs auditors challenge the validity of the dispatch intake receipt, claiming the demurrage lien was forged.

missions.reason: Customs claims the treaty cylinder was tampered with; the negotiator needs the depot intake terminal scanned to prove the postal factor logged the late fee fraudulently.
missions.private_fact: The terminal logs prove the postal factor altered the intake timestamp by twelve days to trigger the automatic maximum forfeiture tier.

beats.public_change: The flagship customs interdictor moves to block the consular docking lane by force of arms.

missions.reason: The customs cutter has blockaded the approach to the consular dock to seize the cylinder; the negotiator needs the interdiction broken so the treaty can be ratified.
missions.private_fact: The customs captain hails mid-fight offering to drop all tariff liens and pay a bounty if the pilot surrenders the cylinder for quiet incineration.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot defeats the customs cutter and delivers the intact treaty cylinder to the consular mooring.
resolutions.summary: The treaty is signed and trade borders reopen. {role:postal_factor} is stripped of his postal license for demurrage fraud, saving {role:canton_miners} millions.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blasted through an armed customs blockade to deliver a misfiled treaty held hostage for late fees.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the customs buyout or the parcel is impounded during transit.
resolutions.summary: Customs burns the treaty cylinder in secret. {role:postal_factor} pockets the demurrage payout, and {role:canton_miners} face harsh retaliatory trade embargoes.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot declines the jobs and the standoff remains unresolved.
resolutions.summary: Customs gunboats storm the automated depot and arrest {role:postal_factor} for treason. The treaty is impounded, plunging the system into an armed tariff dispute.

loose_threads.detail: Unpaid postal demurrage vouchers across three systems are traded as junk derivatives by an offshore clearing house.
The courier freight bill lists the treaty canister's weight as four hundred kilos rather than four, triggering heavy-freight fees.
The customs cutter's combat transponder broadcast an encrypted identity token registered to a private security firm.

radio_hooks: Automated postal depot at {role:depot_rock_nine} locks vaults over disputed two-credit handling fee.
{role:canton_miners} threaten full export strike unless diplomatic mail pouch is released immediately.
Customs cutter {role:customs_interdictor} deployed to enforce storage liens against orbital mail lockers.

voice_direction.postal_factor: Clips each consonant sharply, citing subsection bylaws and fee schedules with pedantic relish. Never admits error.
voice_direction.canton_negotiator: Frantic, breathy cadence with high-pitch bursts when discussing deadlines. Shifts tone abruptly to smooth diplomatic flattery.
